info.title: EMS-ExpressJS API
info.description:
Employee Management System REST API. All endpoints except /auth/login|refresh|logout|forgot-password|reset-password require `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

Success envelope: `{ success, message, data, meta? }`. Error envelope: `{ success:false, error:{ code, message, details?, requestId } }`.

post.summary: Log in; returns access + refresh tokens
Rotate refresh token and get a new access token
Revoke every session of the current user
Reset password with a single-use token
Create an employee (optionally with a login account)

get.summary: Employee by id (fields depend on viewer: admin / self / directory)

put.summary: Update an employee (records job history on org changes)

get.summary: Full hierarchy (cycle-safe, depth-limited, optional department scope)
List holidays by date range / location

put.summary: Replace weekly-off days for a location

post.summary: Mark notifications read (all, or by ids)
